title: Saikyou no Kensei, Bishoujo Maid ni Tensei Shi Houki de Musou Suru
titleRomaji: Saikyou no Kensei, Bishoujo Maid ni Tensei Shi Houki de Musou Suru
titleNative: 最強の剣聖、美少女メイドに転生し箒で無双する
synonyms: The strongest sword saint is reincarnated as a beautiful maid and becomes unrivaled with a broom
synopsis: Arnoick, the strongest Sword Saint in history, has died. His sword techniques were passed on to his disciples, and it was thought that his story had come to an end— But then…! Arnoick is reincarnated as a breathtakingly beautiful maid named Annette! With her slender arms and frail body, she should have given up the path of the sword and lived a quiet, peaceful life. However, in order to protect Rosalena, the daughter of a fallen noble family, she rises up broom in hand. An ultimate do-over fantasy of the strongest warrior reborn—from old man to beautiful girl! (Comic Gardo Translated)
chapterSourceTitle: Saikyou no Kensei, Bishoujo Maid ni Tensei Shi Houki de Musou Suru

title: Welcome to Undead Park
synopsis: The largest theme park in America has been overrun by a zombie virus. Sung-heon finds himself trapped with his daughter among zombies and foreign tourists with whom he cannot communicate. In this unprecedented disaster where any moving living creature, not just humans, is turned into a zombie, Sung-heon struggles with his injured leg to save his daughter. They must survive - from the zombies, and from them. (Source: KakaoPage, translated)

synopsis: When Yiren catches her fiancé and her crafty sister Rielle kissing, something in her snaps. She decides she must get married in order to escape her family. Yiren happens to learn that the icy, aloof Noel Cristan is looking for a bride in order to inherit his father's title of archduke. With all the family drama and intrigue, will Noel's family be any safer for Yiren? (Source: Tapas)

synopsis: One day out of boredom, Tanaka decided to give her classmates nicknames based on their quirks. Her friend Kikuchi became "Ota" for her nerdy interests, and her other friend Saginomiya became "Robo" because of her expressionless personality. synopsis: Ako Kobayashi is a high school girl eagerly awaiting her prince charming to sweep her off her feet, but she has to overcome one small problem: she is so afraid of guys that she breaks out in hives whenever she comes near one. She even rejects the popular Kei Kitaooji who is the first guy to ever ask her out. However, after Kei learns of Ako's condition, he comes to school the next day dressed as a girl and asks her out again

title: I Have a Secret
synopsis: Five high school classmates hold secrets close to their hearts—hidden talents, unspoken feelings, and buried pain. As they collide with each other on the path to growing up, they might jostle some of those secrets free. From Yoru Sumino, acclaimed author of I Want to Eat Your Pancreas and I Had That Same Dream Again comes a gentle, intriguing tale about love, life, and the things we leave unsaid. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: HG ni Koisuru Futari
synonyms: Two Girls in Love with High Grade Model Kits
Two People in Love with HG
synopsis: When she was 14, Sayaka Kanzaki had her first encounter with Gundam, and her fascination for MS was awakened as if by fate. But her family and friends did not understand the hobby, so she had to hide her interest from the world. Until one day, when she met a high school girl, Sora Takamiya, who loved Gundam models, too...! When two people who love Gundam meet, it's the beginning of something new–––. A story about how it feels “to like” something; a “Gunpla” slice-of-life comedy featuring an almost-thirty OL and a JK!! (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Notes - Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category. - Includes 15 extra chapters.

synopsis: After graduating from the Korean National Police University and becoming a detective, Ji-Yong is assigned to investigate a suspicious report and comes face-to-face with a nationwide jeonse scam. As he confronts criminals who slip through the cracks of the legal system without proper punishment, Ji-Yong begins to question the rules of vigilante justice he once set for himself. While pursuing the scam’s ringleaders, the four vigilantes receive a threat from someone who knows their true identities and begin to sense the looming presence of a far greater evil. (Source: WEBTOON)
